Read-only health check over the project's soul; the plugin binary runs every check and prints the report. **Never writes.** An organizational knowledge system is `/knowledge-doctor`'s territory (demarkus-knowledge plugin).

## Run

`$ARGUMENTS`: an optional project slug, and `--deep` to also check metadata lost across versions (one version walk per untagged document). Bash:

```bash
"$HOME/.demarkus/bin/demarkus-plugin" doctor --dir <shell-escaped-absolute-project-dir> [--scope /<slug>/] [--deep]
```

The binary resolves the bound soul from the project directory (`--store <id>` overrides), validates the slug, reads every document in scope once and runs every hygiene check (links, orphans, hubs, metadata, shape, style, ADR sequence and references; a whole-soul audit adds the write-auth verdict).

- Exit 0: print the report verbatim, then a short prioritized "what I'd fix first". "All clean" only when it has zero findings and Coverage says complete; otherwise name the gaps Coverage lists.
- Exit 1: the audit is untrustworthy (store unreachable, unauthorized, inventory bound, broker-tier store, binary older than the subcommand); surface stderr verbatim and stop. Never substitute a manual crawl.

## Don't

- Write or modify anything; a requested fix is a separate, explicit step.
- Fabricate findings or coverage the report does not state.
